title: The Book of Boba Fett
overview: Legendary bounty hunter Boba Fett and mercenary Fennec Shand must navigate the galaxy’s underworld when they return to the sands of Tatooine to stake their claim on the territory once ruled by Jabba the Hutt and his crime syndicate.

title: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
overview: Two outlaws must navigate the galaxy's dangerous underworld as they chart their destinies.

title: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
overview: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.
